summary: Media reads reach Langfuse at last, and the four dialects for "this span is a model call" become one.
details: Read back against the live collector: 1041 traces, and not one of them was a media comprehension — the span declared `plumbing`, so the sampler dropped it as a root, while `nora_media_comprehension_total{status="ok"}` counted the reads happening. Detaching the spawned read from the ingest trace and dropping it were two decisions that had been conflated, including in the test, which asserted the absence as its pass condition. Every branch under that span is a model call, so R-76 keeps it.

The attribute spelling Langfuse renders a generation from lived once, in `nora.obs.tracing.generation`, instead of being hand-rolled at the two call sites that had it and absent from every other — corrected here from an earlier draft of this note, which described that as the current state after a later change (2026-09-19) replaced it: the raw call sites now spell a generation through `nora.agent.telemetry.start_raw_model_span`/`end_raw_model_span`, thin wrappers around `strands.telemetry`'s own `Tracer`, which is upstream-maintained rather than a second in-repo copy of the same vocabulary.
